question: Where should Hari be worshipped after establishing the arghya vessel and other implements?
premises: The arghya vessel and other implements are established.
The middle seed-syllable is the locus of worship.
Hari is to be worshipped there.
inference: After establishing the arghya vessel and other implements, one should worship Hari in the middle seed-syllable.
plain_english: Having established the arghya vessel and so on, one should worship Hari in the middle seed-syllable.
